en.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab A9+
en.shortDescription: 11" budget-friendly tablet with quad speakers, great for streaming.
en.description:
## Samsung Galaxy Tab A9+

An 11-inch LCD display with quad speakers tuned by AKG, ideal for streaming and family use.

- 4 GB RAM, 64 GB storage with microSD expansion
- 7040 mAh battery
- Wi-Fi only, no SIM slot

## Samsung Galaxy Tab A9+

Shaashad LCD 11 inch ah oo leh afar weheliye oo uu dhisay AKG, ku habboon daawashada iyo isticmaalka qoyska.

- 4 GB RAM, kayd 64 GB oo lagu kordhin karo microSD

- Wi-Fi kaliya, lama geliyo SIM
